CRITICAL CORRECTION, discovered while investigating an identical issue on topic 004: all three of these "drafts" were never actually drafts. Buffer auto-published all three within ~2 minutes of creation on 2026-08-06, because schedulingType:"automatic" auto-publishes at the next open queue slot regardless of saveToDraft:true — a bug/limitation not caught at the time because the post's live status was never re-verified with get_post after creation. This means the sensitive content decisions in this topic (identifying the couple as Jewish, vaguely gesturing at a real tragedy, the marriage/divorce framing Agata explicitly waived a sensitivity caveat on) went live publicly on 2026-08-06 without her ever giving explicit final approval to publish — she approved the content's wording, not its publication. Flagged to Agata 2026-08-10 as an urgent incident. Root cause and fix documented in .claude/skills/publishing-handoff/SKILL.md's "Critical Buffer limitation" section. Buffer's API does not support deleting or editing a post once status is "sent" — any correction to these three live posts would need to happen directly on LinkedIn/Instagram/Facebook, not through Buffer.
